answer: Divergent challenge auction: each identity must answer a fresh random challenge within seconds, and its answer becomes an anchor that later clones must reproduce exactly. A clone farm cannot make its copies diverge, so when two identities return identical answers to a challenge seeded with per-identity nectar, the pair is flagged and both forfeit a penalty equal to ten times the registration fee. An attacker also pays the cost of a unique live operator per identity, since any shared responder leaves an echo that links the whole cluster.
